_comment: Example gotcha registry for gotcha-lint (Pattern D graduation). Copy to your project repo as .gotchas.json and edit. Only mechanically-greppable gotchas belong here; context-dependent ones stay as briefing notes injected into review briefs. See docs/gotcha-lint.md.

gotchas.description: Pest toThrow(\Throwable) falls back to message-substring matching, so the assertion passes for the wrong exception.
gotchas.hint: Assert a concrete exception class: toThrow(MyException::class).

gotchas.description: cascadeOnDelete() on a history/audit-bearing FK lets a single hard delete vaporize the whole trail.
gotchas.hint: On history-bearing FKs prefer nullOnDelete() + softDeletes(). (Context-dependent — briefing only; review the FK before flipping enforce.)
